description: This Java source file defines the `CreditBureauConfigurationHelper` class, which contains utility methods for managing credit bureau configuration data in integration tests for the Fineract platform. It includes methods for creating, updating, and retrieving credit bureau configurations, organization credit bureaus, and related JSON serialization helpers, but they are marked as deprecated and intended for testing purposes.

classes.name: CreditBureauConfigurationHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing credit bureau configurations in integration tests, providing methods to create, retrieve, update, and delete configurations, as well as manage organization credit bureaus.

methods.name: getCreditBureauConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a specific credit bureau configuration by ID.

methods.name: createCreditBureauConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new credit bureau configuration with specified key, value, and description.

methods.name: updateCreditBureauConfiguration
methods.description: Updates an existing credit bureau configuration by ID and returns the updated value.

methods.name: getOrganizationCreditBureauConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves organization-level credit bureau configuration data.

methods.name: addOrganisationCreditBureau
methods.description: Adds a new organization credit bureau with specified alias and status.

methods.name: updateOrganisationCreditBureau
methods.description: Updates the activation status of an existing organization credit bureau.

methods.name: addOrganizationCreditBureauCreateAsJson
methods.description: Serializes new organization credit bureau data to JSON.

methods.name: updateOrganizationCreditBureauCreateAsJson
methods.description: Serializes updated organization credit bureau data to JSON.

methods.name: creditBureauConfigurationAsJson
methods.description: Serializes credit bureau configuration data to JSON.

methods.name: updateCreditBureauConfigurationAsJson
methods.description: Serializes updated credit bureau configuration data to JSON.
